assumptions: The C37 whole-witness embedding is used only as repository-bound source geometry; the merged 160-parent reduction catalogue remains exact d(7)=6 candidate coverage only.

The new edge-split family is required to satisfy the frozen local high-port source geometry, simplicity, planarity, complete stars and semidegree footprint; it is not claimed to consist of minimum counterexamples or globally generated L_join children.

The fixed-interface repetition argument uses complete valid colorings, boundary colors and both-color positive reachability, plus the ordinary arbitrary-exterior segment-replacement proof; no independent S11 verification is claimed.
C45/C46 and mission-supplied AE/M12 statements are source-separated and are not imported as C37 high-port transition theorems.

atomic_claims.text: For every n>=1 and every binary spoke word of length n, repeated splitting of the C37 witness edge 12-13 yields a simple plane triangulation with d(7)=6+n, all new vertices degree four with indegree=outdegree=2, and the displayed exact rotations; hence no finite degree cutoff covers all locally source-valid high-port states.

For the constructed edge-split family with fixed boundary (7,5,12,13), infinitely many unresolved prefixes are impossible in a minimum-order counterexample: the full strong boundary profile is finite, so two prefixes repeat a profile and the later prefix has a strict source-valid profile-preserving replacement by the earlier one.

A same-principal dual-implementation CPython 3.13.5 control checked the structural all-one family through n=64, all-one profiles through n=12, and all 510 binary spoke words through n=8; only the one-port word 1 lacked a shorter-prefix replacement in that bounded census.

A sufficient architecture for S02-A is a bounded-interface/escape-rank dichotomy: closed bounded-interface steps terminate by finite strong-profile compression, while every interface release, separator crossing or complete-star escape must strictly decrease an independently proved well-founded rank rho; then (rho, profile-DAG height) is lexicographically well founded.

failed_route_proposal.blocker: The explicit edge-split family has d(7)=6+n for arbitrary n while preserving the local source embedding, simple orientation and semidegree footprint, so finite degree cutoff or any raw-complexity measure increasing along this family cannot prove termination.

objective: Adversarially search for an infinite or arbitrarily long source-valid C37 d(7)>=7 high-port chain, distinguish raw source expansion from an actual unresolved reduction-child pump, and isolate the first structural termination premise needed by S02-A without importing C45 or AE/M12 across source boundaries.
risks: The parametric family proves unbounded locally source-valid geometry, not that every G_n is a minimum counterexample or is generated by the still-open global L_join mapper.

The finite-profile blocker is proved only for a closed four-port interface with complete internal stars and source-valid shortcut guards; growing interfaces, separating triangles and arbitrary new exterior contacts remain open.
The 510-word computation is bounded and same-principal; it is not an independent verifier receipt and supplies no induction step.
C45 higher-degree behavior and the mission-only AE/M12 shell claim have no repository-bound bridge from the C37 d(7)>=7 source and are not used.
B-criticality, L_join, independent arbitrary-exterior lifting verification and the root remain open.
